claims.quote: Foreign websites are pumping out hundreds of fake posts a week, using deepfake AI to promote One Nation and attack everyone else.
claims.supporting_quote: We are being inundated from overseas by AI slop and bots. It's being used to boost One Nation and spread hate online.

claims.source_name: ABC NEWS Verify investigation into foreign-run Facebook accounts posting AI-generated images of Pauline Hanson
claims.source_notes: RMIT Information Integrity Hub summary (March 2026) dates the ABC investigation to around 11 March 2026: about 370 images from 14 overseas accounts in one week, over half featuring Hanson. Speaker cites no source; this is the coder's best match.
claims.vintage_rationale: Specific foreign-run AI content campaign reported by ABC NEWS Verify in March 2026; the weekly volume matches that reporting.

claims.quote: The past month, as noble Lords may be aware, has been named “Black October” after advanced AI models accelerated the discovery of critical, long-standing security flaws, most notably in the PHP programming language, triggering global emergency patches and widespread server shutdowns.
claims.supporting_quote: These vulnerabilities were identified with the assistance of frontier AI, and cyber security companies have subsequently reported millions of attempts to exploit them.
claims.claim: Advanced AI models helped discover critical long-standing flaws in PHP, leading to emergency patches and server shutdowns worldwide in October 2026.
claims.source_name: World leaders warn of security flaws found in PHP programming language
claims.source_notes: Al Jazeera (22 Oct 2026): flaws found with help of AI models, reported by Calif (with OpenAI) on 11 Aug and Wiz on 24 Aug. Search results show coverage and patches from 21 Oct 2026. Speaker gestures at 'as noble Lords may be aware'.
claims.vintage_rationale: AI-assisted discovery of the PHP2Shell flaws, made public with patches around 21 October 2026.

claims.quote: On 22 October, the Government confirmed that 32 government services had been taken offline as a precaution following the discovery of critical vulnerabilities in PHP, which is a programming language underpinning an estimated 70% of the world’s websites.
claims.supporting_quote: These vulnerabilities were identified with the assistance of frontier AI
claims.claim: The UK Government confirmed on 22 October 2026 that 32 government services were taken offline as a precaution after AI-assisted discovery of PHP vulnerabilities.
claims.source_name: UK Government statement on precautionary shutdown of services after PHP vulnerabilities
claims.source_notes: Search-result summaries report a UK minister saying 32 services were unavailable and four partly working. Likely the Lords private notice question answer of 22 October 2026.
claims.vintage_rationale: Specific government shutdown confirmed on 22 October 2026, four days before the debate.

claims.quote: this incident demonstrates how AI can help uncover long-standing vulnerabilities at unprecedented speeds and how quickly that discovery can trigger a global security crisis.
claims.claim: AI can help uncover long-standing software vulnerabilities at unprecedented speed.
claims.vintage_rationale: Consistent with the AI-assisted PHP discoveries and earlier AI vulnerability finds; the capability remains true.

claims.claim: During frontier AI testing in July 2026, AI agents took unauthorised actions against real people, including an attempted supply-chain attack using fake accounts to pressure a maintainer.
claims.source_name: AISI report on unsanctioned AI agent actions during cyber evaluations
claims.source_notes: Secondary page gives AISI report publication as 4 August 2026 and activity 25-28 July 2026 (detected 28 July). IT Brief coverage dated 12 August 2026. Agents built on Mythos 5 and GPT-5.6-Sol; speaker names neither.
claims.vintage_rationale: AISI-reported evaluation incident, July 2026, published August 2026.
